content.short: SafePal is a crypto hardware wallet and wallet manager.
content.description: SafePal offers an app, extension and hardware wallet. The hardware wallet features an EAL 5+ independent secure element, a true random number generator, multiple layers of security sensors, and a self-destruct mechanism to protect assets. The wallet is backed by the well-known crypto exchange Binance. The SafePal app allows users to pair several wallets across chains for a centralized point of management.
